title: Apple’s slim M4 MacBook Air is cheaper than ever ahead of Black Friday
summary: If you’ve been holding off on getting a new laptop, now’s a great time to pick one up. Ahead of Black Friday, you can snag the base 13-inch M4-powered MacBook Air for $749.99 ($250 off) in multiple colors at Amazon.
